name: Aspen
about: Winter (Dec–Mar) is the main draw, summer brings hiking and music festivals, shoulder months see many businesses close.
overview: One of America's original ski towns, where Victorian-era mining wealth gave way to some of the country's most expensive real estate.
costOverview: One of America's most expensive mountain towns — even a casual coffee or lunch runs high, and the lift ticket alone can cost more than a full day elsewhere.
